20261122-chemistry-g09-2.title: Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.goal: Codso mabaadi'da Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide si aad u xalliso dhibaatada baaritaanka.
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.material: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) wuxuu si aad u gaabis ah ugu kala jabaa biyo iyo oxygen heerkulka qolka. Marka budo yar oo madow oo manganese dioxide (MnO₂) ah lagu daro, xumbo (gaaska oxygen) ayaa si xoog leh u soo baxay. Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide?
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.prompt: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) wuxuu si aad u gaabis ah ugu kala jabaa biyo iyo oxygen heerkulka qolka. Marka budo yar oo madow oo manganese dioxide (MnO₂) ah lagu daro, xumbo (gaaska oxygen) ayaa si xoog leh u soo baxay. Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide?
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.explain: Manganese dioxide wuxuu u shaqeeyaa sidii positive catalyst oo hoos u dhiga tamarta firfircoonida (activation energy) ee falgalka kala jabka hydrogen peroxide, si aad ah u kordhinaya xawaaraha falgalka, iyadoo cufkeeda iyo halabuurkeeda kiimikada aysan isbeddelin kahor iyo kadib falgalka.
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.hint.0: Cufka iyo dabeecadda manganese dioxide ma isbeddelaan kahor iyo kadib falgalka.

20261122-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.o.o1: Walxaha falgala oo la xidhma hydrogen peroxide si ay u noqdaan xeryo cusub
20261122-chemistry-g09-2.s.s1.o.o2: Walxo nuuxsata oo nuuxsata dhammaan oxygen-ka soo baxa

20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.o.o2: Sababtoo ah birtu waxay lumisaa electrons si ka sahlan zinc
